title: Evaluating the Zero-shot Robustness of Instruction-tuned Language Models
findings: Performance on the 'Hindu Knowledge' task was sensitive to instruction phrasing, consistent with findings on other tasks. Using unobserved (novel) instructions compared to observed (training) instructions led to varied results: a performance drop for some models (e.g., Flan-T5-XL), but stable or slightly improved performance for others (e.g., Flan-T5-XXL and Alpaca-13B), highlighting the model-dependent nature of robustness in specialized knowledge domains.
